title: Thunderbird very slow to sync with gmail
creator: anne234
content:
Thunderbird is taking an hour or more to sync incoming mail with gmail. This has just started to happen in the last month - previously sync was almost instantaneous.

Sometimes Thunderbird will display the incoming email subject but not the content, sometimes it will display nothing for an hour or more after the email was received and can be seen in the native gmail app.

This is not consistently happening, sometimes sync will be immediate.

title: looking for profile after botched computer upgrade
creator: wpmunk
content:
I had the computer store's tech team move my old operation system to the new computer I bought from them. Unfortunately, I did not realize that I needed to locate my profile and save it on the old machine before they moved all of my data to new directories on the new computer.

I THINK I've found the old profile, but ONLY the profile, which I saved and pasted onto my desktop. But I'm not entirely sure it's the profile containing all of my addresses, correspondence, and folders, and when I tried to paste it into a new installation it doesn't work.

Is there a way to "live" assistance on this project? ..... it seems that I'm having trouble following written instructions! thanks
